versions.changelog: Verify the pinned runtime executable and selected model with SHA-256 before every upscale, including custom cache directories. Keep absolute Windows PowerShell resolution, lazy algorithm profiles, download-size reporting, and tested conservative portrait routing.

Harden Windows image processing by resolving PowerShell from the absolute SystemRoot path and removing PATH from the child environment. Also refine automatic portrait routing based on same-size visual comparison: clean AI and studio portraits use the balanced default, while portrait mode is reserved for noisy, compressed, or rough natural photos.

Add lazy algorithm profiles for balanced, fast, natural photo, portrait, digital art, and sharp-detail upscaling; show advantages, trade-offs, cache status, and incremental download sizes; improve conservative automatic selection with tested clean-AI-portrait routing; keep heavy PyTorch and diffusion models optional; expand bilingual documentation.

Add 1K and 8K presets, custom long-edge output, strict KB/MB compression, quality-only mode, recursive batch compression, dry-run planning, image inspection reports, bilingual README, and reduced Windows subprocess environment exposure.
Initial release: verified local 4K upscaling for macOS and Windows, high-fidelity and lite models, aspect-ratio preservation, batch mode, offline cache, and mirror fallback.
